title: スプリンターズSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Sprinters Stakes, Sakura Bakushin O and Nishino Flower—both training mates of Yamanin Zephyr's—declare that they mean to win the impending race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling that beating them will make her an even faster wind, Zephyr can't wait to start running. The second clash on her way to triple-distance champion is moments away!
